chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Hello there! In this tutorial series, you are going to learn everything about the Python programming language.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And just to get started, I will cover two major parts.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Number one, why choose Python in the first place?

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Number two is going to be about how to get started.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: First of all though, why choose Python in the first place?

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And for that, you have to be aware that there are hundreds of programming languages.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And usually, a language is made for a specific purpose.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For example, JavaScript was initially developed to make websites interactive and super shiny.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Although ever since then, it basically expanded to do pretty much everything.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Python on the other hand was originally developed to teach people coding.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Back then, it wasn't even meant to be an actual programming language.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: But over time, it grew very fast and was steadily expanded,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and eventually it became a real programming language,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: that was actually surprisingly popular.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Today, actually, Python is arguably the most popular programming language.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: With that, we are getting a couple of advantages.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Most importantly, because of its history, Python is incredibly easy to learn and to use.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: It is incredibly streamlined, very forgiving, and makes it super easy to find mistakes.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: On top of that, there is a huge community around Python.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Which is amazing if you have a question or want a tutorial.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Because somebody probably already asked a question or made a tutorial on it.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Also, because of this huge community, there are lots of expansions to Python,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: that all make the language even more useful.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Finally, Python is primarily used for data analysis, artificial intelligence,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and servers or data stuff in general.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Jobs that are very much in demand and generally well paid.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: However, you have to be aware that there are some disadvantages when it comes to Python.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: The most noticeable one is that Python is comparatively slow.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: It sacrifices speed to be more flexible and easy to use.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Which in most cases is not going to matter for your specific purpose.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Which for most cases isn't really going to make a difference.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And lots of modules in Python are actually getting around this limitation.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Where you notice this limitation the most is in game development.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Now, you can make games in Python, but it's not really a professional thing.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Most of the time it's either a hobby or a way to learn programming.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you want to learn actual game development, you would want to use a game engine.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Like Godot, Unreal or Unity.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Besides that, Python isn't really used for apps or user interfaces.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Once again, you could be using it for that purpose, but there are better tools available.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: You would rather use React or something like Flutter.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Which are giving you significantly more and better tools.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Finally, Python is giving you less control over the hardware.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Now this in most cases is a kind of control you don't really care about.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For example, in other languages you could control the memory management of your computer.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And if you don't know what that means, don't worry too much about it.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: You are probably not going to use it in the first place.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: The general philosophy of Python is to abstract all of these problems away.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: So you can focus on the actual logic of what you are trying to achieve.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: With that, you might have the question.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you are just starting, what programming language should you start with?

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And for that question, Python is usually a good answer.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Mostly because it is incredibly easy to learn.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: What you can do, if you don't end up liking Python or want to do something else.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: It is very easy to switch to another programming language and then retain most of the knowledge.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Programming languages share a lot of ideas.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Meaning if you know Python, it becomes significantly easier to learn something like C++ or JavaScript

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: or literally any other programming language.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Alright, now with all of that, we have to talk about how to use Python.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And there are two steps to that.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Number one, we have to install Python itself.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: It's just going to be another file on your computer.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: After that, we are going to need a code editor.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: I am going to use Visual Studio Code, or VS Code in short.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Which is I think the most popular code editor.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Although there are quite a few alternatives.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Sublime, PyCharm and Atom are really popular ones as well.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And there are loads more.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you already know some coding and you have a code editor that you really like to use,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: you can totally keep on using that one.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Alright, so let's get started on how to install Python.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For that, you want to go to Google and type something like Python download.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Or simply Python should also be good enough.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Then the first result should be the official Python website.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Click on that and then you can see a Python download button.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: At the moment, the most recent version of Python is Python 3.12.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Which is what I am going to use for this tutorial.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you click on that, a download should start.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Once this one is done, you can go to your downloads folder.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Double click on the Python symbol and then you should get the install dialog.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Before you click on install now, there is one really important thing you have to do.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And that is to add python.exe to path.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you are on Windows.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: On Mac OS, this is happening automatically.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: But on Windows, you have to make sure that you are adding Python to the path.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: That way a code editor could find the program and use it to run Python.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you are not ticking this box, you are going to have lots of errors.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: So make sure to tick it.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And then click on install now.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: You can also customize the installation, but you don't really need to.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Then you have to wait a few seconds and after that you should have Python installed.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Next up, we have to get a code editor.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And in my case, I want to use Visual Studio Code or VS Code in short.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For that, go back to your search engine of choice and type in VS Code download.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: The first result should be what you need.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And on that website, you can choose your operating system.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: In my case, I am working on Windows.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: But obviously, if you are on Mac OS, click on the Mac download button.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Click on the icon and then you can install it like any other program.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: I would recommend to keep all the default options.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: But do make sure that you have the add to path ticked.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: That one does matter.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: After all of that is done, you can click on launch Visual Studio Code.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Which is what I want to do.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Once you have done that, you should be seeing something like this.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Now, the main window you don't really have to worry about too much.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: What is rather important is on the left side.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: There you have a couple of icons that are much more important.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For example, at the top we have the explorer.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And in there you can see all of your open folders and files.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: As a matter of fact, while we are here, I want to open a folder,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: which I am going to use for all of my files.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Meaning I want to open a folder, and then you should be seeing something like this.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Basically what you want to do is to create a folder with all of your code.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: In my case, I already have a path that I want to work in.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: So let me paste it in.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And there I want to select a code folder, which at the moment is entirely empty.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: With the folder selected, I want to click on select folder.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And then nothing has really changed.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Although now, if we are clicking on the explorer again, we can see code,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and we can see that there is nothing inside of the folder.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: To fix that, I want to right click, and then create a new file.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: This file now needs a name. Let's call it setup.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: We will need .py as a file ending, so our computer knows that we have a python file.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If we are doing that, you also get the python icon, a little snake on the left side of it.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And if I now press enter, we can write some code.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Also, we still have the welcome tab, this one you can just close.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Also, if you look at the bottom right, there you can see we have python.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And if you click on python, you could select another language, but this is not what I want to do.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Instead, I want to write some incredibly simple python logic.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And for that, I want to write the word print.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Then use parentheses, then quotation marks, and in quotation marks the word test.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Or whatever word you want to print.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Make sure you are spelling this in the exact same way.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For all programming languages, you have to make sure that you don't have typos,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and parentheses and quotation marks are really important.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Alright, with that we have one line of python code.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: But now we have to figure out how to run all of this.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And this we can't really do right now.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For that, you want to look on the left side.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: There we have extensions.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: This you want to click on, and then you already get a recommendation

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: that you should install a python extension for VS Code.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you cannot see this one, simply type in the search bar python,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and it should be the first result.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: This is what we want to install.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: It's going to take a few seconds, and then we have python installed.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you now go back to setup.py,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: in the top right, you can see a run python file symbol.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you click on that, you get a terminal, and in there we have test.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: This is the word we have just written inside of the print statement.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And that is all that print does.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: It simply prints out a word.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And with that, we have some basic python setup.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Now, you can customize VS Code quite a bit.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For example, what is really popular is,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: I think this is called material icon.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: This is a purely visual extension.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: At the moment, if you are looking at the explorer,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: the python symbol looks a bit boring.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And for that, if you are installing material icon,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: or any other theme, let me install material icon,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and then you have to select an icon theme.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: SETI is the default one, but I want to use material icon theme.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: So click on that.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And now, if you go back to the explorer,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: the python symbol looks significantly better.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And that's all that's happening in here.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: There are loads more extensions you could be using,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: but to get started, you don't really need any more.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Also, you can close the tab with the extension,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and the new welcome tab.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: We will not be needing any of those.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: However, what you might want to do,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: is to customize a few more minor things.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Like the font size, for example.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you are watching all of this on a smartphone,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: the text is going to be really small.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For that, you want to go to file,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: then to preferences,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and in there, we have settings.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you click on that, you can customize basically anything

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: inside of VS Code.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For example, there we have the font size.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: You can set this one, for example, to 20.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And if you now press CTRL S to save,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: go back to setup,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: you have much larger text.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: You can also use search settings,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and type in something like terminal font size.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Usually VS Code is very good with the search function.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: There we have integrated font size for the terminal.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Let's change this one to maybe 20.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And now, we have much larger text.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Could even be a bit larger,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: let's say something like 24.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: That looks about right.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Simply choose the number that you like.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: It's entirely up to you.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: These numbers are fairly subjective,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and also depend on your device.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Simply play around with them,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and see what feels right.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Now besides that, what you can also do,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: if you go back to file, preferences,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and there we have keyboard shortcuts.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Those can be quite nice.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For example, what I might want to do,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: instead of always clicking on the execute or run python file,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: I want to bind this to a shortcut.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And for that, you go to keyboard shortcuts,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and then use the search function.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: I want to use a shortcut for run python file.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And there we have the command,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and if you double click on keybinding,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: you can set a shortcut.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: In my case, I'm going to use alt and a,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: which is a shortcut that isn't used by VS Code,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: but is also very easy to use on your keyboard.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you now press enter,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: you can go back to setup.py,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and instead of clicking on the symbol,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: you can, let me close this actually,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: you can simply press alt and a,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and you get the same result.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Makes the entire thing much faster to work with.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Nearly done.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: The last thing that I want to cover is a full screen mode.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And the shortcut for that is a bit weird.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If you go to view,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: there you have appearance,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and if you go to full screen, or zen mode,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and the shortcut for zen mode is ctrl k,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: then you release the keys, and then the z key.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Or you can simply click on it, same result.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: But if you want to get out of it,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: you press ctrl k, and then you release ctrl,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and then press z.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: That way you go back.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: The keyboard shortcut does get a bit of time to get used to,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: but once you do, it's actually quite nice.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And I am going to write most of my code in something like this.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: That way it's going to be quite a bit easier to focus on one thing at a time.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: But other than that, we can still run the code via the symbol,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: or we can press ctrl a,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: you're getting the same outcome.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Also, what you can do,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: if you go back to file, and preferences,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: under settings,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: you can customize the zen mode quite a bit as well.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: For example, in my case, I don't really like the center layout.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: If I now go back to setup.py,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and go back to zen mode,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: we have the code all the way on the left.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And in settings, you could also hide

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: the tabs, those are the icons at the top,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: to switch between files.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: Since I am mostly going to work with a single file,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: I am going to set this to none.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: That way, if I now go to setup,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: and go back into zen mode,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: we only have the one python file.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: And that, I think, at least to get started,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: is a really good setup.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: But once again, simply choose what you like the most.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: There is no universal answer for any of this.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: But anyway, with all of that,

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: we have a setup of python.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: So next up, we can work on writing some actual python logic.

chunks.title: Intro & Setup
chunks.text: I'll see you there!
